In the error path, the expectation reference is not released before dropping the packet, contributing to the leak.
The closing brace of the if block (and likely the function end) marks the point where the expectation reference should have been released but was not.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition calls nf_ct_expect_related() which uses a reference to the expectation without releasing it afterwards, causing a reference leak on both success and failure paths.
In the error path, the packet is dropped without releasing the expectation reference, contributing to the leak.
The closing brace marks the end of the error-handling block where the expectation reference should have been released but was not, leaving the reference leaked.
